tools.name: get_experience
tools.title: Get music experience
tools.description: Fetch a published MusicDibs music experience by its public share token (the token in a /play/{token} link). Returns the public title, message, audio URL, call-to-action and playback stats. Only works for experiences the tenant has published.

token.description: The public experience token, e.g. the value in /play/{token}.
